purpose: Make the distinction between source discovery, PDF acquisition, digital-scan acquisition, API evidence and non-download content explicit before a 3192-cell acquisition run.
principles: Registry presence never implies PDF acquisition capability.
API/search sources are evidence and discovery unless acquisition is explicitly enabled.
PDF acquisition requires a concrete real PDF or permitted complete scan plus item-level rights review.
No .pdf.enc is accepted as an acquired PDF.
Canonical Arabic Quran remains separate from human and machine translations.
Unknown or review-required rights remain protected and are never promoted to public redistribution.

capability_classes.pdf_acquisition: Concrete PDF download or an adapter explicitly marked acquisition/PDF capable.
capability_classes.digital_scan_acquisition: Complete or materially complete digitized manuscript/book surrogate; item-level permission still required.
capability_classes.discovery_only: Catalogue, bibliography, manuscript index, search or provenance source without a concrete acquisition route.
capability_classes.api_evidence: API/structured content used for search, language enumeration, verification or metadata; not a PDF release route unless acquisition is explicitly enabled.
capability_classes.content_review: Islamic educational/dawah/content site useful for discovery/review but not automatically a downloadable-book source.
